court: Supreme Court of the United States
statute_version_applicable: Pre-ECPA; Fourth Amendment analysis that prompted Congress to enact Pen Register Act (1986)
rule_established: No Fourth Amendment protection for numbers dialed from telephone; third-party doctrine applies to pen register metadata; voluntary conveyance to carrier = no reasonable expectation of privacy
subsequent_limitation: Carpenter v. United States, 585 U.S. 296 (2018) — narrowed third-party doctrine for comprehensive CSLI; Smith not overruled but limited in scope
